subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session age/turn rotation, and what canonical config shape, defaults, and memory-continuity behavior should it use?
rationale: The fix adds public lifecycle configuration and automatic reset behavior that can affect transcript continuity, provider/session state, and memory persistence.

options.title: Add explicit core reset caps
options.body: Extend the canonical session reset policy with max-age and max-turn caps, durable accounting, and safe continuity hooks before rotating sessions.

options.title: Keep external hygiene for now
options.body: Document cron/manual/session maintenance patterns and avoid expanding runtime config until the lifecycle semantics are clearer.

options.title: Fold into broader session-boundary design
options.body: Resolve this together with token-pressure split, rolling pruning, and pre-reset memory flush so OpenClaw has one lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Add explicit core reset caps
recommendation.body: Extend the canonical session reset policy with max-age and max-turn caps, durable accounting, and safe continuity hooks before rotating sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The daily reset baseline and memory flush history make this the strongest routing candidate for the product/config choice.
